dialogues.jp: 「う〜……寝よ寝よ」
dialogues.en: "Hoo... time for bed."
dialogues.text: "Hoo... time for bed."

dialogues.jp:
遠足の前日にわくわくしすぎて、当日寝不足に
なるってのは良くある話だ。
dialogues.en:
Unsurprisingly, it's hard to fall asleep the day before a
big event.
dialogues.text:
Unsurprisingly, it's hard to fall asleep the day before a
big event.

dialogues.jp:
でも、もはやそんな歳でもない俺には、今夜も
いつものように眠気が訪れましたとさ。
dialogues.en:
But I'm not some youngun anymore. I know when I need to go
to bed.
dialogues.text:
But I'm not some youngun anymore. I know when I need to go
to bed.

dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ……」
dialogues.en: "Good night..."
dialogues.text: "Good night..."

dialogues.jp: 「Ｚ……ぐあっ？」
dialogues.en: "Z...gwah?!"
dialogues.text: "Z...gwah?!"

dialogues.jp: 旅だった眠りの王国は、他人の領地だった。
dialogues.en:
As I explored the kingdom of dreams, I came across uncharted
territory.
dialogues.text:
As I explored the kingdom of dreams, I came across uncharted
territory.

dialogues.jp: 「これじゃあ、明日、寝不足になるじゃねえか」
dialogues.en: "I need to get enough sleep for tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "I need to get enough sleep for tomorrow."

dialogues.jp: （一体、どこよ、ここ……）
dialogues.en: "(Where on earth is this place...)"
dialogues.text: "(Where on earth is this place...)"

dialogues.en: "Wah... wahh.... *sniff*"
dialogues.text: "Wah... wahh.... *sniff*"

dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp:
子どもだった。少女が泣いている。手の平をぐ
しぐしと顔に擦り付けて。
dialogues.en:
It was a kid. A small girl, crying. She was wiping her eyes
with the back of her hand.
dialogues.text:
It was a kid. A small girl, crying. She was wiping her eyes
with the back of her hand.

dialogues.jp: ことりだ。
dialogues.en: It was Kotori.
dialogues.text: It was Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ことりの夢を見ている──しかも、これ
は、悲しい夢だった。たぶん。
dialogues.en:
Looks like I'm seeing Kotori's dream--but it looks like a
sad one...
dialogues.text:
Looks like I'm seeing Kotori's dream--but it looks like a
sad one...

dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.jp:
呼びかけておいて、自分で驚いてしまう。どう
して、俺の姿が……？
dialogues.en: Her apparent reply shocked me. Why can she see me...?
dialogues.text: Her apparent reply shocked me. Why can she see me...?

dialogues.jp:
違うのだった。いつの間にか、俺のそばに、一
人の小柄な人間が立っていた。
dialogues.en:
No, no... sometime while I wasn't looking, a short person
had appeared beside me.
dialogues.text:
No, no... sometime while I wasn't looking, a short person
had appeared beside me.

dialogues.jp: （ばあちゃん……？）
dialogues.en: "(Grandma...?)"
dialogues.text: "(Grandma...?)"

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんだった。昔、俺の家の隣に住んでい
た、自称魔女の。
dialogues.en:
It was grandma. The grandma who used to live next door to
us, and a self-declared witch.
dialogues.text:
It was grandma. The grandma who used to live next door to
us, and a self-declared witch.

dialogues.jp:
全く……神出鬼没だな。苦笑を噛み殺しつつ、
懐かしい姿に笑みが浮かんでしまう。
dialogues.en:
Man... she appears in the worst of places. Stifling a bitter
smile, I watched her nostalgic, laughing figure.
dialogues.text:
Man... she appears in the worst of places. Stifling a bitter
smile, I watched her nostalgic, laughing figure.

dialogues.jp:
俺とは対照的に、ことりは不安そうにばあちゃ
んを見上げていた。
dialogues.en:
In contrast to my reaction, Kotori furtively looked up at
grandma.
dialogues.text:
In contrast to my reaction, Kotori furtively looked up at
grandma.

dialogues.jp:
それも、仕方ないかもしれない。ばあちゃんは
金髪｛へきがん／碧眼｝の外国人なのだ。きっと、子どもの目
には怖く映るんだろう。
dialogues.en:
Not surprising, really. After all, grandma is a blond,
blue-eyed foreigner. Most kids here are wary of that.
dialogues.text:
Not surprising, really. After all, grandma is a blond,
blue-eyed foreigner. Most kids here are wary of that.

dialogues.jp:
（黒船来航時代に残された絵なんて、まるきり
　化け物だもんな……）
dialogues.en:
"(Anyone who doesn't ride the good black ship are probably
monsters to them...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Anyone who doesn't ride the good black ship are probably
monsters to them...)"

dialogues.jp:
（というか、どこをどう見たら、あんな風に見
　えるんだよ……）
dialogues.en:
"(Anyway, what am I talking about with this right in fromt
of me...)
dialogues.text:
"(Anyway, what am I talking about with this right in fromt
of me...)

dialogues.jp:
そんな関係のない事を考えている間に、ばあちゃ
んは、ことりの目の前にしゃがみ込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
As my thoughts wandered away from the current situation,
grandma squatted down in front of Kotori.
dialogues.text:
As my thoughts wandered away from the current situation,
grandma squatted down in front of Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
のみならず、何と、泣いていたことりが笑顔を
浮かべているではないか。
dialogues.en: Eventually, Kotori started smiling tearfully.
dialogues.text: Eventually, Kotori started smiling tearfully.

dialogues.jp:
もぐもぐ動く口に、唇に付いたあん──さては、
まんじゅうで懐柔した？
dialogues.en:
Her mouth's movements showed she was chewing something. Her
lips-- is that manjuu on it?
dialogues.text:
Her mouth's movements showed she was chewing something. Her
lips-- is that manjuu on it?

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「良かったわ、ことりちゃんが涙を引っ込めて
　くれて」
dialogues.en: "That's good, that managed to stop your crying..."
dialogues.text: "That's good, that managed to stop your crying..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「だって、子どもが泣いてるなんて、悲しいも
　のね」
dialogues.en: "Kids' crying are always the most painful kind."
dialogues.text: "Kids' crying are always the most painful kind."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……おいしい」
dialogues.en: "...It's yummy."
dialogues.text: "...It's yummy."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「あら、もう食べ終わっちゃったのね。もっと
　食べる？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh my, you've finished it all already. Would you like some
more?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh my, you've finished it all already. Would you like some
more?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Y, yea..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yea..."

dialogues.jp:
おどおどとした目を向け、それでもこくんとう
なずく。
dialogues.en: Her eyes were hesitant, but her head nodded anyway.
dialogues.text: Her eyes were hesitant, but her head nodded anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「はい、どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Alright, here you go."
dialogues.text: "Alright, here you go."

dialogues.jp:
すっと差し出した手には、既に美味しそうなま
んじゅうが乗っている。
dialogues.en:
Quicker than the eye could see, she created a manjuu onto
her hand and gave it to Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Quicker than the eye could see, she created a manjuu onto
her hand and gave it to Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
にぱっと、大輪の花のような笑みを浮かべる。
本当に、嬉しそうな笑顔。
dialogues.en:
She gave a smile, the cute smile of a large-petaled flower.
It was a smile of true happiness.
dialogues.text:
She gave a smile, the cute smile of a large-petaled flower.
It was a smile of true happiness.

dialogues.jp:
それだけに、マシュマロみたいに柔らかな頬に
跡づけられた涙が、似つかわしくない。
dialogues.en:
It was completely unsuited to her marshmallow-like cheeks,
still stained with tears.
dialogues.text:
It was completely unsuited to her marshmallow-like cheeks,
still stained with tears.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「元気になった？」
dialogues.en: "Are you feeling better now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you feeling better now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Y, yea..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yea..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「そう……良かった」
dialogues.en: "That's good."
dialogues.text: "That's good."

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんが立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Grandma stood back up.
dialogues.text: Grandma stood back up.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「またね、ことりちゃん」
dialogues.en: "See you later, Kotori-chan!"
dialogues.text: "See you later, Kotori-chan!"

dialogues.jp: 小さく手を振る。背中を向けたところで──、
dialogues.en: She gave a little wave. But as soon as she turned her back--
dialogues.text: She gave a little wave. But as soon as she turned her back--

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、まって！」
dialogues.en: "W, wait!"
dialogues.text: "W, wait!"

dialogues.jp:
鋭い声。鋭利な針で、世界の全てをその場に凍
り付かせるような。
dialogues.en:
Her voice cried out sharply. It was a cry so sharp, it
would've stopped the entire world in it's tracks.
dialogues.text:
Her voice cried out sharply. It was a cry so sharp, it
would've stopped the entire world in it's tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 再び、しゃがみ込む。
dialogues.en: Once again, she squatted down to Kotori's level.
dialogues.text: Once again, she squatted down to Kotori's level.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「き、聞いて、お、おばあちゃん……わ、わた
　しね……」
dialogues.en: "P, please listen to me, grandma... I..."
dialogues.text: "P, please listen to me, grandma... I..."

dialogues.jp:
言葉にトゲでも発生したように、つっかえつっ
かえしながら、それだけ口にする。
dialogues.en:
Her words were stuttered, as if she was choking on
something.
dialogues.text:
Her words were stuttered, as if she was choking on
something.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わ、わたし……聞いて、聞いて……」
dialogues.en: "I... please listen, I..."
dialogues.text: "I... please listen, I..."

dialogues.jp:
きいて、聞いて、キイテ、わたしの話を聞いて
……。ただただ、聞いてくれと訴える。
dialogues.en:
Please listen, please listen, p-l-e-a-s-e l-i-s-t-e-n,
please listen to me. She was practically saying it as a last
resort.
dialogues.text:
Please listen, please listen, p-l-e-a-s-e l-i-s-t-e-n,
please listen to me. She was practically saying it as a last
resort.

dialogues.en: "(Who would...?)"
dialogues.text: "(Who would...?)"

dialogues.jp:
そう、誰も。誰もその幼い声に耳を傾ける人は
居なかったのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
That's right, who would listen to some childishly-voiced
plea like that?
dialogues.text:
That's right, who would listen to some childishly-voiced
plea like that?

dialogues.jp: だから、そんなに必死になって……。
dialogues.en: That's probably why she sounds so desperate...
dialogues.text: That's probably why she sounds so desperate...

dialogues.jp: 初対面の人間だというのにそんなに必死に……。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's to someone she's only met for the first
time...
dialogues.text:
Even though it's to someone she's only met for the first
time...

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「なあに？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わ、わたしには……パパも、ママも、お、お
　姉ちゃんの気持ちも……」
dialogues.en: "I, I can't... papa, mama, onee-chan's feelings..."
dialogues.text: "I, I can't... papa, mama, onee-chan's feelings..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だ、誰の気持ちも……分からないの……」
dialogues.en: "E, everyone's feelings... I don't know them..."
dialogues.text: "E, everyone's feelings... I don't know them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「パパも、ママも……お姉ちゃんも……初めて
　会った人だから……」
dialogues.en: "Not papa, not mama... not onee-chan... I just met them..."
dialogues.text: "Not papa, not mama... not onee-chan... I just met them..."

dialogues.en: --Huh?
dialogues.text: --Huh?

dialogues.jp:
言葉が途切れる。ことりは、しくしくと泣いて
いる。
dialogues.en:
She interrupted herself in the middle, and started to sob
again.
dialogues.text:
She interrupted herself in the middle, and started to sob
again.

dialogues.jp: え？　初めて会った人？
dialogues.en: Eh? People she just met?
dialogues.text: Eh? People she just met?

dialogues.jp: 父親も母親も……暦先生も？
dialogues.en: Her father, her mother... and Koyomi-sensei?
dialogues.text: Her father, her mother... and Koyomi-sensei?

dialogues.jp:
俺の混乱も知らぬげに、ばあちゃんは、とても
穏やかにことりの頭を撫でる。
dialogues.en:
Unlike my state of confusion, grandma calmly rubbed Kotori's
head gently.
dialogues.text:
Unlike my state of confusion, grandma calmly rubbed Kotori's
head gently.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「分からないなら、｛たず／訊｝ねてみればいいじゃない」
dialogues.en: "If you don't know, then why don't you try to ask?"
dialogues.text: "If you don't know, then why don't you try to ask?"

dialogues.jp: あくまで優しく。
dialogues.en: Gentle to the end.
dialogues.text: Gentle to the end.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「あなたの気持ちを教えてって……」
dialogues.en: "To learn what they are feeling..."
dialogues.text: "To learn what they are feeling..."

dialogues.jp: 心に染み渡るように……。
dialogues.en: Striking right to the core of the issue...
dialogues.text: Striking right to the core of the issue...

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「あなたは何を考えてるのって……」
dialogues.en: "To learn what they are thinking..."
dialogues.text: "To learn what they are thinking..."

dialogues.jp:
しかしことりは、いやいやをするように激しく
首を振る。
dialogues.en: But Kotori still intently shook her head no.
dialogues.text: But Kotori still intently shook her head no.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わ、分からないの……わ、わたし……」
dialogues.en: "I, I still... don't know..."
dialogues.text: "I, I still... don't know..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとにわからないの……」
dialogues.en: "I really don't know..."
dialogues.text: "I really don't know..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「でもね、ことりちゃん」
dialogues.en: "But, Kotori-chan."
dialogues.text: "But, Kotori-chan."

dialogues.jp:
頭を撫でていた手を下ろし、ばあちゃんはしっ
かりとことりを見つめた。
dialogues.en:
Putting the hand brushing Kotori's head back to her side,
she looked sternly at Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Putting the hand brushing Kotori's head back to her side,
she looked sternly at Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「分かろうとしなければ、人の気持ちなんて、
　分かりっこないのよ……」
dialogues.en:
"Sometimes, it's best not to know what everyone else is
thinking."
dialogues.text:
"Sometimes, it's best not to know what everyone else is
thinking."

dialogues.jp: ことりが涙に濡れた顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori's tearful face looked up at grandma.
dialogues.text: Kotori's tearful face looked up at grandma.

dialogues.jp:
そして、ばあちゃんを｛にら／睨｝んだ。まるで、長年の
｛かたき／敵｝ででもあるかのように。
dialogues.en:
But grandma's gaze was unwavering. This is how she earned
many enemies through her life.
dialogues.text:
But grandma's gaze was unwavering. This is how she earned
many enemies through her life.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わ、分からないよ……ほんとに……」
dialogues.en: "I really... don't know..."
dialogues.text: "I really... don't know..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分からない……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know..."

dialogues.jp: 風が吹いた。舞い散る桜。
dialogues.en: The wind blew past, and the sakura petals started dancing.
dialogues.text: The wind blew past, and the sakura petals started dancing.

dialogues.jp: 初音島の枯れない桜が視界を覆い尽くした……。
dialogues.en:
The swirling sakura petals quickly blocked me from seeing
the rest...
dialogues.text:
The swirling sakura petals quickly blocked me from seeing
the rest...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Young Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆Young Kotori◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見た。ことりの、幼い頃の夢だ……。
dialogues.en: I saw a dream. A dream by Kotori, of her childhood...
dialogues.text: I saw a dream. A dream by Kotori, of her childhood...

dialogues.jp:
夢の中には、ばあちゃんが登場した。そのばあ
ちゃんに向かって、幼いことりは訴えるのだ。
dialogues.en:
My grandma was in the dream as well. She was the one who
Kotori pleaded to listen to her.
dialogues.text:
My grandma was in the dream as well. She was the one who
Kotori pleaded to listen to her.

dialogues.jp: 分からない……。

家族のみんなが初めて会った人だから、だから、
分からないと。
dialogues.en:
Her family were people she just met before, so that's why
she didn't know anything about them...
dialogues.text:
Her family were people she just met before, so that's why
she didn't know anything about them...
